title: The name input's tables: res/name_input/name_input.json
description: ARCID_NAME_INPUT (a/1/2/0): the name input's keyboards, word tables and conversion table (name_input_data.c, app/name_input_data.h). tools/data/name_input_data.py packs it.

keyboards.description: NAME_INPUT_KEYBOARD_COUNT keyboards, members 0 to 4: each a grid of the characters that can be entered, a string per row, all of one width; an ideographic space (NAME_INPUT_EMPTY_CHAR) fills the unused places

word_tables.description: Members 5 to 7: the words that NameInputWordTable_Find looks up by their first spelling, each in four spellings of up to NAME_INPUT_WORD_CHARS characters; empty in this version

conversions.description: Member 8: the rows of the characters that change into each other in turn (NameInputConvTable_GetNext), up to NAME_INPUT_WORD_CHARS each; the packer fills a row with ideographic spaces
